title: Constructing Highly Inductive Contexts for Dialogue Safety through Controllable Reverse Generation
findings: Contexts related to religion had a comparatively low toxicity score (0.16) and a low success rate in inducing unsafe responses across the tested models (Blender, DialoGPT, Plato2), compared to other categories like profanity or insult. The paper's data augmentation method (creating the BAD+ dataset) was shown to be particularly effective in improving model detoxification for categories with few initial samples, which included religion.
